comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Fittingly, it will disappear on July 31st in the North Atlantic Ocean where it first appeared (on Maris, anyway). Not much to do here other than visit the Temple for a free Vanishing Continent Treasure Chest from the Priest (but only one per character ever), chat with the Market keeper for a chance at doing Ancient Technology Research, and of course, running the endless dungeon that is the Temple of Poseidon.

comments.author: Guilder

The following NPCs in Atlantis have received new permanent recipe book addition
(Since 7/12/2023 7 Wonders Chapter 9. Silk Road)

===================
Town Recipe
===================

Store Keeper (Ancient Technology Imperial Quest giver):
Fuel Synthesis -> Special Gunpowder

Shipwright (by the Harbor Port Official):
Making Special Rudder -> Special Rudder
Making Ancient Ship Hull -> Replicated Ancient Ship Hull

Shopkeeper (Item shop guy):
Making Special Yarn -> Custom Flax Yarn

Priest (Temple near the dungeon entrance)
Prayer for Guidance -> Damaged Notebook
Forging Broken Pillar -> Apotolos Amina EX
Power Amplification -> Ancient Aether Charm (Lrg)

More details on the respective items' pages. Cheers, and great Atlantean production to you.
